tells: 1. Hands-on-table pose cloned across the front row: pink-jacket man, green-hoodie man, white-shirt woman, purple-top woman and grey-shirt woman all rest both hands flat on the table edge in the same symmetric posture, fingers splayed like rest pose; nobody holds a drink, leans back, crosses arms or props a chin (club-1-wide.png, front row centre; club-6-held.png, tables centre-right)

2. Laugh onset in the strip is a head turn plus mouth opening only: no breath intake, no shoulder hitch, no torso fold back or forward, no hand to face until the white-shirt woman's wrist flips up at t=12.8; the purple-top and grey-shirt women barely change across all six frames, so the laugh does not build or spread (club-5-strip.png, all frames, centre-right pair)

3. Face close is a game-cinematic mannequin: waxy uniform orange skin with no pores or vellus, eyes with flat painted irises and a hard specular dot, lips a smooth pink shell with no moist interior, half-smile frozen with no cheek raise or crow's feet (club-4-face.png, centre face)

4. Hair is helmet geometry: the pink-jacket man's and the purple-top woman's hair are solid shells with no flyaways or strand breakup, and the face-close ponytail is a smooth painted tube that reads as plastic against the blurred background (club-2-mid.png, left and centre-right heads; club-4-face.png, top of head)

5. Weight and seating don't register: thighs float above chairs with no seat compression, chair legs and feet vanish into black, cups sit on the tables without contact shadow, and the back-row people are flat black cutout silhouettes with identical standing poses (club-1-wide.png, lower half and back wall silhouettes; club-3-mid.png, right background)

1. Rows of identical rigid seated poses: in the wide nearly every front-row person sits bolt upright, knees apart, both hands placed on the knees in mirrored symmetry like a T-pose dropped into a chair; the second row stands/sits stiffly with arms hanging, giving a police-lineup look rather than an audience (theatre-1-wide.png, front two rows centre)

2. Floating and clipping: second-row figures hover above and in front of their seat backs with no seat contact, the man top-left of the mid shot has a translucent halo/ghost torso, and a pink diagonal limb pokes out between the blonde woman and the purple-top woman (theatre-2-mid.png, upper left and centre; theatre-6-held.png, centre behind blonde)

3. Laugh barely happens over 1 s: only a few mouths open by t=12.8 to 13.0, bodies stay locked to their chairs, no one rocks back, claps, covers the mouth or turns to a neighbour; the light-blue-shirt woman's jaw drops without any face or shoulder engagement, and the right-hand man's head simply droops (theatre-5-strip.png, all frames)

4. Face close shows a dead open mouth: jaw hinged down with a dark untextured cavity and no teeth or tongue detail, no cheek lift or eye squint to match a laugh, brows flat, eyes unfocused and dull; skin is airbrushed with no texture, the short hair is a painted cap (theatre-4-face.png, centre face)

5. Back stands read as a cloned silhouette field: dozens of upright identical black cutouts with the same head-shoulder shape and spacing, no seat rows or heads turning, plus floating standing figures at the left edge in the house dark (theatre-1-wide.png, upper half and left edge; theatre-3-mid.png, upper right)

1. Hand-on-knee pose repeated down the whole row: every visible person sits forward with both hands on the knees, fingers draped the same way, elbows locked; no phone, drink, crossed legs, arm on a neighbour's chair or slouch (openmic-1-wide.png, front row; openmic-3-mid.png, all front figures)

2. Bodies interpenetrate and lack seats: the row is packed so tightly that shoulders and arms overlap (denim-jacket man into the curly-haired man, green-shirt woman into the hoodie woman), chairs are barely visible, and the wide shows people stacked like a choir riser with no visible seating (openmic-6-held.png, centre row; openmic-1-wide.png, centre)

3. Laugh in the strip is two mouths opening and a couple of head turns: the green-shirt and hoodie women open mouths at t=12.6 to 13.0 but their torsos, shoulders and hands are frozen; the yellow-shirt man and denim man are unchanged; no build from smirk to laugh, no contagion (openmic-5-strip.png, centre pair vs. left men)

4. Eyes and mouth inside read CG: the hoodie woman's lips are flat black with a dark painted mouth interior, eyes have dark smudged sockets; the face-close man has glassy pale irises with no wet line or lid shadow and a frozen closed half-smile (openmic-2-mid.png, centre-right face; openmic-4-face.png, eyes)

5. Hair and skin are game assets: the yellow-shirt man's hair in the close is a stiff shell with a noisy dithered edge and a black clipping chunk behind the ear, skin is smooth and uniform with a soft bloom halo around the silhouette; light-skinned pink legs on the hoodie woman read as bare plastic (openmic-4-face.png, behind ear and outline; openmic-3-mid.png, lower centre legs)
